purpose: Ten additional image-only game art proposals after actual multi-agent brainstorming. Three favored-direction refinements plus seven new or improved grammars; not all materials unprecedented.

prompts.title: Hành lang thành đất
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE wide 16:9 proposed GAME SCREENSHOT, a fictional ancient Vietnamese-inspired living-world social RPG, not a historical reconstruction. Everyday work and a readable meeting between adults, not combat or character creation. Graphics must be authored consistently across spatial geometry, full bodies, one player portrait, useful objects and interface. Make the portrait match the SELECTED PLAYABLE adult's age/hair/clothes; a square-corner ground marker identifies that same adult. A DIFFERENT round speech pointer belongs only to the NPC. UI uses only two short Vietnamese labels requested, large on calm solid areas, with useful pictograms. No other writing, title, watermark, minimap or stat bars. No photorealism, film lighting, generic RPG parchment HUD, ornate fantasy armor, pagodas, Chinese writing, anime-child faces or excessive microtexture. This is an image preview, not actual runtime or a render from an existing built scene. GRAPHIC RULE: monumental virtual3D made of FOUR OR FIVE HUGE SOLID EARTH PLANES with sharp clean cuts, almost no surface texture. A low three-quarter camera inside an earthen communal work passage, foreground human figures take a third of image height rather than tiny dots in grand scenery. Massive plain warm red-earth wall on one side, a broad cream ramp on the other, one dark open raised timber work platform bridging above. A patch of cool gray river beyond one gap, no distant mountains/details. Tall broad adult PLAYER woman carrying two timber pieces, cropped dark hair and off-white short tunic; older short wiry NPC woman in subdued black-indigo wrap points toward a communal drying platform. Both have elongated adult proportions, geometric hands/noses, solid matte planes and visible age difference, no rounded baby heads. Foot placement and one access ramp obvious. Use only red-earth, warm chalk, charcoal and cool gray; crisp broad shadows and quiet empty ground. UI is a vertical stack of two massive rectangular blocks in the wall's unused margin with a carved-angular matching player portrait; labels exactly 'Hỏi đường lên' and 'Nhật ký'. No rough muddy paintwork, ropes, baskets, many roofs or dense scaffolding. Visual change from ordinary isometric village comes from enclosing large masses, human-scale camera and sculptural adult silhouettes, not rusty color grading.

The graphic bank/river border guides exploration without becoming an omniscient management diagram. No animated-flow arrows, route stats, map pins, water reflections or roof textures. Strong composition of few readable flat interlocking forms, not an isometric picture.

GRAPHIC RULE: a stylized virtual3D village with a CLEARLY CURVING PERIPHERAL CAMERA, while the nearby two adult bodies stay straight and readable. Ground, distant roof axes and tree trunks turn along the visible curve toward BOTH image edges; not merely a winding path. A broad communal courtyard and low river landing extend beyond the frame, no tiny planet/ball underside or literal drum. TWO adults close to center: tall thin gray-haired PLAYER man with a slight stoop holding a woven basket of broad leaves, and a wide-shouldered middle-aged woman gesturing to a dry platform. Small heads relative to adult bodies, visibly large workworn hands, simple geometric but soft solid silhouettes, no chibi faces or cute grandmother toy scene. Far homes are just five broad rounded matte shapes, no thatch strands/fences/many residents. Palette pale jade background, desaturated plum garments, warm gray ground and a small cream interaction cue; subdued local color without orange/teal grading. UI is a short shallow arc with ONLY two broad action shapes and matching angular-soft player portrait: text exactly 'Đặt giỏ' and 'Trò chuyện'. Keep interface empty enough to read, curve must not distort the type or people. No hearts as player marker, no romantic status implied. Make world-scale camera distortion visible in architecture without making world a spherical object.

prompts.title: Phù điêu đang sống
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: a virtual2.5D RAISED RELIEF WORLD with genuine-looking SHALLOW THICKNESS on EVERY silhouette, viewed nearly front-on with a slight oblique angle showing thick side edges and narrow dark gaps. NOT a flat painted fresco, metallic historical artifact, carved texture filter or photo of a tablet. Public raised workfloor, person shapes, simple posts, folded mat and one boat edge are all solid raised slabs sharing one shallow plane; cast shadows reveal the same thickness logic. No fully round bodies. PLAYER is an older heavy-set adult with gray short hair and a broad asymmetric draped torso slab carrying a rolled mat; lean adult NPC at an upright loom extends a large flat hand. Faces are economical relief profiles and portraits with recognizable age lines, no realistic skin or ornate carving. Three flat pigments only: faded rose-red raised faces, warmchalk recesses, near-black depth edges, small darkblue selected bracket. Large uncluttered empty areas. UI consists of two recessed pockets with a shallow matching PLAYER portrait, flat plain labels exactly 'Trả tấm chiếu' and 'Nhật ký'. No ornamental border, mythical pattern or archaeological inscription. The structural shallow depth must be obvious on people's silhouettes, objects AND architecture, not just a wall surface. Looks like an unusual side-on narrative game, not a museum plaque.

prompts.title: Người bằng cử chỉ
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: radical FLAT2D GRAPHIC ANIMATION shapes with NO OUTLINES, NO modeled gradients or realistic anatomy. Body silhouettes organized around large working gestures: PLAYER is a broad adult woman in deep purple carrying a large ochre basket against one hip, one bent elbow makes a huge clear negative-space triangle; an old lean man in chalkwhite leans over a long reed mat with oversized hand/forearm shape. Adult head-to-body ratios, age-specific posture, no generic chibi avatars. Their work objects interlock with the silhouettes and empty gaps, making the gesture readable before any facial detail. Landscape is only four or five asymmetric matte planes: teal-gray public platform, darkpurple raised-house legs, pale gray river stripe, one ochre tree mass; no perspective realism or detailed picturesque background. Low side-oblique composition with figures big and full-body, visually bold like a playable animated graphic system, not promotional poster. Matching player's face portrait also only six or seven flat shapes, same hair/garment. Interface is an asymmetric arrangement of two broad offset flat blocks using same shape rhythm, labels exactly 'Giúp trải chiếu' and 'Đồ mang theo'. Black outlined square-corner player marker is the one necessary functional contour, round NPC speech pointer distinct. NO decorative scattered triangles, fairy glow, texture noise or cinematic color wash.

prompts.title: Cửa trong cửa
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: stylized virtual3D EYE-LEVEL scene composed through THREE SUCCESSIVE MASSIVE OPENINGS made from dark timber posts and crossbeams. Clear occlusion: one near post crops the edge of the frame, a second big porch opening surrounds the meeting, a third frame reveals a small patch of river. Not a long monumental stone corridor or portal magic. Bodies close enough to feel adult height, environment has only large chunky plane groups with zero thatch/woodgrain clutter. PLAYER is a short thick-set older adult woman with broad shoulders, gray bun, simple indigo garment, holding a folded cloth bundle; her full body stands in near opening. Tall young-adult NPC in muted brickred reaches toward bundle from public porch. Faces and hands are deliberately chunky angular planes, no realistic detail. Muted cream daylight, indigo timber shadows, plain clay-red planes and small jade selected brackets, no orange bloom. Match player portrait to gray bun/indigo. UI uses the unused negative margin inside the nearest frame: two discreet SOLID inset rectangles, text exactly 'Giao tấm vải' and 'Trò chuyện'. Readable walking patch between adults; back rooms closed rather than xray. Strong framing/depth through blockers is the whole art proposition, not a landscape painting with a black decorative border. No doors as teleporters, lens blur, HUD minimap or knowledge overlays.

prompts.title: Khối ghép đời thường
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: both people and world built from a TINY NUMBER OF LARGE WEDGE AND PRISM VOLUMES, like a virtual3D tangram sculptural system. Crisp orthographic three-quarter view shows front/top/side faces. Each character has ONE big trapezoid torso, TWO wedge legs, simple bent prism arms, ONE angular head wedge; not dozens of polygon facets on conventional realistic bodies. NO cubic voxel grid, joints, folded continuous terrain, cloth pleats, microtexture or paper photograph. PLAYER is a tall narrow adult with block of gray cropped hair and one broad shoulder wedge carrying a single triangular-ended reed basket; older broad NPC with short white hair and a low torso prism points to a flat communal landing. Strong different age/weight silhouettes, visible feet and oversized useful hands. House only six big prisms; boat is one huge long pointed wedge with a simple hollow top, water plain dark green slab. Restrained matte colors deepgreen, faded coral, chalk and nearblack edge shadows. Interface itself is two large wedge-shaped solid tabs with matching prism-face portrait and single-shape useful icons; labels exactly 'Giúp chuyển giỏ' and 'Nhật ký'. Make the geometry startlingly COARSE and authored, not ordinary 'low-poly' realistic village with triangular texture. No map or tiny inventory clutter.

prompts.title: Sát mặt nước
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: a distinctive stylized virtual3D SOCIAL GAME viewed from just above a BOAT GUNWALE, near water height. Huge simple boat side slices diagonally through foreground, long horizontal river band and raised porch make two further depth layers. No overhead isometric overview, mountain panorama, photoreal water or cinematic lens effects. Main adults take up much of frame: PLAYER is a stout middle-aged adult woman with cropped dark hair, slate-blue sleeveless work wrap, full body visible standing inside open boat carrying an ochre jar; an old lean ferryman in chalk tunic stands at low public landing offering his hand. Their feet have clear separate support surfaces, hands/heads simple asymmetric chunky faces with adult proportions, no generic hero or toy baby. The boat and posts have smooth large cut planes, water flat deepink with only two broad reflection shapes; background is a few pale horizontal blocks, not a detailed village. UI anchored to empty near boat-side margin as two large painted plane plaques, matching player portrait with same cropped hair and wrap. Text exactly 'Đưa bình' and 'Trò chuyện'. Square-corner marker clearly inside player's boat floor, round NPC speech pointer near landing man. View is a game camera proposal, not secret remote view, first-person disembodied hands or actual scene render.

prompts.title: Pixel cự ly gần
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: deliberately CRISP2D PIXEL ART, close fixed side-three-quarter camera, VERY LARGE adult sprite clusters and limited palette, not a pixelation filter over a painting and not3D voxel blocks. One small open communal workshop and landing, TWO main adults full-body each about a third of the image height. PLAYER is a tall narrow older adult woman with conspicuous gray cropped hair, darkpurple short tunic, carrying a jade-green rolled reed mat; shorter broad adult loom worker in chalk garment reaches with a long clear bent elbow. Different adult body silhouettes, large readable hands, no tiny generic sprite crowd or chibi heads. A few bold stair/platform/loom shapes with hard pixel edges, wide solid negative spaces; no microtiles, no far village panorama, no bloom, no depth-of-field, no elaborate water animation, no gradients. Palette about a dozen carefully chosen colors in inkpurple/jade/chalk/ochre, controlled stepped pixel shadow clusters. The matching player portrait is also chunky pixelart with same gray hair/tunic; big sharp legible Vietnamese UI text may be clean HD type inside two plain pixel-bordered windows. Text exactly 'Trả tấm chiếu' and 'Đồ mang theo'. Functional player ground corners and rounded speech pointer have distinct shapes. This improves legibility and camera distance from a dense wide pixel RPG shot; don't imitate a specific existing game.

prompts.title: Âm bản sống
prompts.prompt:
GRAPHIC RULE: the WORLD is carved by LARGE CONTINUOUS NEGATIVE-SPACE CAVITIES through TWO THICK FLAT PLATES, while PEOPLE remain POSITIVE SOLID forms in front. Slightly oblique near-front view makes the thickness and occluding edges of the cutouts visible. A broad cream plate's sweeping aperture defines an open public landing and house-post gaps; second near-black plate behind gives one continuous deepblue river opening. NO detailed village recolored white, no realistic wall material, line mesh, stencil painting, shadow puppets or full spherical worlds. Main PLAYER a short broad gray-haired older adult woman, chalk face and muted red solid draped body carrying a large simple oval basket, stands on the visible near edge; lean youngadult NPC in darkblue stands beside a single solid boat wedge. Full opaque heads, expressive age/posture and big simple hands, no ghost bodies or hidden information behind closed walls. Architecture and route are read through just three or four huge cut gaps, forms stop cleanly at occlusion. UI occupies two quiet CUT-OUT RECESSES in the near plate, matching solid portrait of selected gray-haired woman, labels exactly 'Hỏi chuyến' and 'Nhật ký'. Deepindigo, warmchalk, nearblack and one mutedred accent only. Graphic controlled game geometry, large calm negative spaces, no artboard or museum plaque. Cutting is a presentation language, not an ability to see through or reshape the actual world.

iterations.title: Vành sân — phép cong hình khối
iterations.prompt: Create ONE wide16:9 stylized videogame screenshot of a CURVED VILLAGE SPACE made of HUGE SIMPLE MATTE FORMS. The curved projection must be UNMISTAKABLE: at both edges the axes of tree trunks and porch posts fan outward, roof blocks tilt with the horizon, ground arcs upward toward the sides. Central two ADULT PEOPLE stand nearly straight, tall and thin versus short and broad, both grown adults with small angular heads and large expressive hands. The selected adult is a thin gray-haired older man in a darkplum solid torso block holding a broad oval basket. The other adult is a broad middle-aged woman in chalkwhite pointing to a simple drying slab. They are boldly designed sculptural cartoon GAME CHARACTERS, about six heads tall, not chibi, not realistic humans. THREE broad building blobs only in palejade, warmgray empty ground, darkplum clothes and chalk accents. NO DETAILED VILLAGE, NO REALISTIC FACES OR SKIN, NO ROOF STRANDS, NO STONE TEXTURES, NO FABRIC CREASES, NO MOUNTAIN PANORAMA, NO GLOW, NO PHOTOGRAPHY. Make the forms as reduced as game blockout graphics, but intentionally shaped and expressive. Ancient Vietnamese-inspired public stilt porch and boat landing, a fictional graphic setting not historical reconstruction. The scene continues outside frame, no visible underside or little spherical planet. Bottom interface is a simple shallow curved slab with matching simplified gray-haired PLAYER portrait and ONLY two plain labels exactly 'Đặt giỏ' and 'Trò chuyện'. Player marked with hollow square corners, NPC marked with round speech tail. One image preview only, no actual model/scene/render has been built. No extra text, logo or minimap.
